comment: Equipment definitions in FEET. `length` is the feed axis - material runs that way through the machine - and `width` is across it.

items.label: Marvel Series 81 band saw
items.note: Marvel 81 / M2 / M3 series - vertical tilt-frame saw. Material feeds through the 5' side, so the 8' dimension runs across the material path: roller table at the front, band-wheel frame behind it, motor and hydraulics at the back. Footprint is the rough figure given, not a spec sheet. The frame tilts for mitres, which needs its own side clearance - not modelled yet.

items.label: Forklift
items.note: Counterbalance truck. Length includes the forks; height is the mast lowered. Travel paths come in Phase 5.

items.label: Material rack
items.note: Cantilever rack: 20' of frame in 5' bays, arms 4' apart, 5' deep. Holds 24' stock, which overhangs 2' each end.

items.label: 10' manual brake (Baileigh BB-12014)
items.note: Baileigh BB-12014 box-and-pan brake. 10' bend length, but 12'-2" overall - the frame carries counterweights past each end. 34" deep, 48" tall, 3,410 lb. Clearances are still typical figures.

clearance.label: 6' operator side for the sheet, 3' behind for the counterweight swing

items.label: 12' hydraulic shear
items.note: Guillotine shear - housing with the blade beam, support table out to the operator, pendant control on a stand. Bed length is the 12' given; depth, height and clearances are typical figures.

clearance.label: 10' to load the sheet, 5' behind for the drop
